sents.t: Rosa helps me a lot, so I want to say thank you.
I invite her to dinner at Bella’s, an Italian restaurant on Main Street.
“Good evening! Do you have a reservation?” a woman at the door asks.
“Yes, a table for two. My name is Sam.”
He brings water and the menus.
Rosa orders a glass of lemonade, and I order iced tea.
First, we share some garlic bread.
For dinner, Rosa has the spaghetti with meatballs, and I have the chicken with vegetables and a salad.
The food is wonderful, but American plates are very big!
I can’t eat everything, so Mike gives me a box.
I can take the food home.
After dinner, I ask for the check.
In America, people usually leave a tip of fifteen to twenty percent.
“Thank you, Sam. This is a lovely evening,” Rosa says.

comp.q: Why does Sam invite Rosa to dinner?
o: He wants to say thank you.
comp.fa: چرا سام رزا را به شام دعوت می‌کند؟

comp.q: What kind of restaurant is Bella’s?
Why does Mike give Sam a box?
comp.fa: چرا مایک یک جعبه به سام می‌دهد؟
